general_conditions: Two productive field days. On March 10 the crew opened the curbs at RTU-1 and RTU-2 and found deteriorated deck at the RTU-1 opening; the curb set at RTU-1 is on hold pending the engineer's direction. The OAC meeting was held that afternoon. On March 11 the engineer walked RTU-1 and gave verbal direction for a deck repair, written direction to follow. RTU-2 curb work continued. No lost time either day.

sections.title: SUMMARY (DAYS AT A GLANCE)
items: March 10: curbs opened at RTU-1 and RTU-2. Deteriorated deck found at the RTU-1 opening; curb set at RTU-1 held.
March 10: weekly OAC meeting held with the owner and engineer (minutes filed separately).
March 11: the engineer walked RTU-1 and gave verbal direction for a deck repair; written direction to follow.
March 11: RTU-2 curb adapter set and roofed in.

sections.title: TRADES / PARTIES ON SITE OR ENGAGED
rows: PM both days: curb openings, deck condition at RTU-1, OAC meeting, coordination with the engineer
Opened roofing at RTU-1 and RTU-2; roofed in RTU-2; weatherproofed RTU-1 at day end
Jordan Lee: verified disconnect locations at RTU-1 and RTU-2
Alex Poe: OAC meeting; site walk at RTU-1

sections.title: RTU-1 DECK CONDITION (PCO-001)
items: The deck at the RTU-1 opening is deteriorated along one side and will not support the new curb as is.
The engineer gave verbal direction on March 11 to add support steel and replace the affected deck section. Written direction to follow.
Notice of concealed condition sent to the owner and engineer per the contract. PCO-001 will follow with a full breakdown.

sections.title: OAC MEETING (3/10)
items: Weekly owner, architect/engineer and contractor meeting held on site.
RFI-001 (start-up and commissioning sequence) is with the engineer for response.

sections.title: SCHEDULE
items: The RTU-1 deck repair now gates the RTU-1 unit set. RTU-2 remains on schedule.
Weather is tracked separately for any time only (no cost) extension.

sections.title: SAFETY
items: No incidents, injuries, or near misses reported either day.
Open curbs covered and weatherproofed at day end. Roof edge protection in place.

sections.title: LOOK AHEAD
items: Receive written direction from the engineer for the RTU-1 deck repair, then submit PCO-001.
Confirm the duct transition order with Sample Supply.
Set RTU-2 and reconnect power, controls, gas and condensate.
